title: An Abhainn a Nocht Croíthe
intro: Samhlaigh arm ag máirseáil, tartmhar agus tástáilte, áit a scarann ​​​​ordú amháin ag bruach abhann rúndacht ó mhian. Treoraíonn ceannaire roghnaithe na foirne i dtreo namhaid chumhachtach, agus muinín acu in Allah amháin.
clues: Cheap Allah mé mar cheannaire ar Chlann Iosrael tar éis dóibh duine a iarraidh chun troid ar a bhealach.
Tugadh flúirse eolais agus stádais dom mar chomhartha ar mo rogha, cé gur cheistigh mo mhuintir mo údarás.
Chuaigh mé amach leis na fórsaí agus dúirt mé leo go ndéanfadh Allah tástáil orthu le habhainn.
Thug mé rabhadh nach mbeadh aon duine a d’ólfadh go saor uaidh de mo chuid féin, ach amháin an té a thógfadh dornán de.
Thrasnaigh mé leis an mbeagán a d’fhan daingean, agus iad os comhair arm i bhfad níos mó ó thaobh líon de.
Bhí mé i gceannas ar na daoine a dúirt cé chomh minic a sháraíonn cuideachta bheag cuideachta mhór le cead Allah, sular ruaigeadh Jalut.

trial.label: Triail/Imeacht
options: Ag tógáil áirce roimh an tuile
Á chaitheamh isteach i dtine fhuar
Ag codladh i bpluais ar feadh blianta fada
Ag tástáil an airm le habhainn roimh an gcath
trial.answer: Ag tástáil an airm le habhainn roimh an gcath

outcome.label: Toradh
options: Ag slogadh an domhain le seoda
Claochlú ina apaí le haghaidh sárú
Bua le cead Allah agus maraíodh Jalut ag Dawud
outcome.answer: Bua le cead Allah agus maraíodh Jalut ag Dawud

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
